messages:
emma: heads up — need to shift the post-deploy smokewatch window by 30m for the 09:00 release. CDN team is doing an unplanned edge config push that may spike synthetic probe p95. can we pin eu and us-central for the first 15m?
raj: +1 to shifting the window. what's the exact window change?
emma: change from 09:00-09:30 to 09:30-10:00. request: pin traffic to stable model variant (v2.1.3) in eu-west1 + us-central for 09:30-09:45 and enable graceful fallback to cpu-fallback pool.
deploy-bot: deploy 1748882222 starting rollout to prod, canary in eu-west1 started (10% traffic). see: https://deploys.redwood/1748882222 
sara: seeing early canary spike on synth probe in eu-west1 — probes returning intermittent 503s, p95 1200ms at 09:04. attaching logs.
emma: thanks — can you paste the probe snippet?
sara: here — `GET /healthz  -> 200` succeeded locally, but synthetic agent logs show repeated `503 from inference-proxy` and `kv-cache miss` around the same time.
raj: hmm, could be a warmup race on new model variant. we can: 1) pause rollout, 2) pin to v2.1.3 in the hit regions, 3) enable fallback. preference for pin+fallback unless error rate continues. :thinking_face:
tom: if we pin, we should also update the release notes to mention the temporary pin and why. small snippet to add: "Temporary pin to v2.1.3 in eu/us-central during CDN edge config change to avoid probe-induced flapping."
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0310 - eu-west1 synth 503 spike, severity: low, assigned: sara
sara: suggested immediate action: `deploy-bot pause` canary, then run a quick health loop: ```for r in eu-west1 us-central; do curl -sS https://proxy.$r.redwood.internal/healthz || echo fail:$r; done``` results: eu-west1 fail, us-central ok.
emma: ok pause canary now and pin the two regions to v2.1.3 for 15m. raj will coordinate fallback enabling.
deploy-bot: canary paused by emma at 09:07. rollout hold placed.
raj: enabling graceful fallback policy `fallback.policy=cpu-fallback,threshold=5%` for those regions now. will also set `model.pin=v2.1.3` via rollout override.
raj: pinned and fallback enabled. will monitor for 10m, then we can either resume or rollback.
sara: after pin+fallback, eu-west1 synth p95 down to 300ms — still higher than baseline but stable. no new 503s in last 2m. :thumbsup:
emma: good. i'll push a quick release notes patch to the doc: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-10 — adding a note about pin+fallback and the reason.
tom: also add a short blurb to the change window log so SRE knows the shifted window: "Window shifted 09:30-10:00 due to CDN edge push; pin applied 09:07-09:22."
oncall-bot: INC-2026-0310 updated: status monitoring, severity unchanged.
emma: decision: keep rollout paused, observe until 09:22, then resume canary to 20% if synths look good. if any regression, we'll rollback 1748882222 and unpin. agreement?
raj: agreed.
sara: agreed, will keep watch and post final synth metrics at 09:20.
tom: thanks all — nice and quick. :rocket:
